description: Read-only: how many complete company pages this MFM account can still read (first 30 days: 10 profiles per day and 30 companies per month; then 10 every 5 minutes, 40 per day and 100 companies per month (UTC day and month; shared by website and AI)) and how many selections (40 per calendar month, shared with the website), with reset times (UTC). Nothing is consumed. Clients that only expose search and fetch get the same answer from search with the query "quota" or from fetch with the id "quota".
name: quota_status
title: MFM account quota status
